scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run check:api-generated && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/iroc-website run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/iroc-app run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/iroc-portal run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/spirecut-patient run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/spirecut-mobile-redirect run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/spirecut-mobile run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
